# RBAC matrix

Source of truth: `backend/app/domain/rbac.py`. Seeded into the `roles`, `permissions` and `role_permissions` tables by migration; `test_rbac_catalogue_is_read_only_and_matches_code` asserts the database matches.

Coarse permissions only. Row-level visibility (own / direct reports / departments headed / approver on the request / all) is applied in queries — see `visibility_clause` in `backend/app/modules/procurement/service.py`.

## Roles

| Role | Name | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `employee` | Employee / Requester | Raises purchase requests and tracks their status |
| `manager` | Manager / Approver | Approves requests raised by direct reports |
| `department_head` | Department Head | Approves high-value and emergency requests for the department |
| `procurement_officer` | Procurement Officer | Owns vendors, sourcing reviews and purchase orders |
| `finance_analyst` | Finance Analyst | Monitors budgets, invoices and spend |
| `finance_manager` | Finance Manager | Approves budget exceptions and payments; owns budgets |
| `vendor` | Vendor | External supplier user; limited to its own orders and invoices |
| `org_admin` | Organization Admin | Configures users, structure and policy; does not approve spend |
| `platform_admin` | Platform Admin | Operates the platform; no access to tenant business data |
| `read_only_analyst` | Read-only Analyst | Read-only access to requests, vendors and analytics |
